\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{تولید} \fa{کردن} (towlid kardan)}{تولید کردن (towlid kardan)}]{\fa{تولید} \fa{کردن} (towlid kardan) — to produce, to manufacture}

\label{lesson:FA-C383-towlid-kardan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for an organisation, then the Persian for professional.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{تولید} \fa{کردن}}
\textbf{\fa{تولید} \fa{کردن}} (\emph{towlid kardan}) — \textquotedblleft{}to produce, to manufacture\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{این} \fa{کارخانه} \fa{کفش} \fa{تولید} \fa{میکند}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{in kârkhâne kafsh towlid mikonad.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
This factory produces shoes.
\end{quote}

\emph{Towlid} \textquotedblleft{}production\textquotedblright{} + \emph{kardan} (stem \emph{kon-}).

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{تولید}} is usually traced to Arabic \emph{tawlīd} \textquotedblleft{}generating, bringing forth\textquotedblright{}, from the same Arabic family as \emph{tavallod} \textquotedblleft{}birth\textquotedblright{}; \emph{kardan} \textquotedblleft{}to do\textquotedblright{} is inherited Persian.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{towlid kardan}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{towlid kardan}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{towlid kardan}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for an organisation, then the Persian for professional, then say \emph{towlid kardan} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \fa{تولید} \fa{کردن} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}To produce, to manufacture\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{محصول} (mahsul)}{محصول (mahsul)}]{\fa{محصول} (mahsul) — a product; a crop}

\label{lesson:FA-C383-mahsul}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for professional, then the Persian for to produce.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{محصول}}
\textbf{\fa{محصول}} (\emph{mahsul}) — \textquotedblleft{}a product; a crop\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{محصولات} \fa{این} \fa{شرکت} \fa{خیلی} \fa{معروف} \fa{است}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{mahsulât-e in sherkat kheyli ma'ruf ast.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
This company's products are very well known.
\end{quote}

Plural \emph{mahsulât}. Also a harvest from the land.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{محصول}} is usually traced to Arabic \emph{maḥṣūl} \textquotedblleft{}yield, what is obtained\textquotedblright{}: a product or a crop is what work brings in.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for professional, then the Persian for to produce, then say \emph{mahsul} again
\end{itemize}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{رقابت} (reqâbat)}{رقابت (reqâbat)}]{\fa{رقابت} (reqâbat) — competition, rivalry}

\label{lesson:FA-C383-reqabat}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to produce, then the Persian for a product.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{رقابت}}
\textbf{\fa{رقابت}} (\emph{reqâbat}) — \textquotedblleft{}competition, rivalry\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{رقابت} \fa{بین} \fa{دو} \fa{تیم} \fa{خیلی} \fa{سخت} \fa{بود}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{reqâbat beyn-e do tim kheyli sakht bud.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The competition between the two teams was very tough.
\end{quote}

\emph{Reqâbat kardan} — to compete.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{رقابت}} is usually traced to Arabic \emph{raqāba}, from the same Arabic family as \emph{raqīb} \textquotedblleft{}rival\textquotedblright{} (EtymDB), the source of Persian \emph{raqib}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{رقیب} (raqib)}{رقیب (raqib)}]{\fa{رقیب} (raqib) — a rival, a competitor}

\label{lesson:FA-C383-raqib}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for a product, then the Persian for competition.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{رقیب}}
\textbf{\fa{رقیب}} (\emph{raqib}) — \textquotedblleft{}a rival, a competitor\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{رقیب} \fa{ما} \fa{قیمتها} \fa{را} \fa{پایین} \fa{آورد}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{raqib-e mâ qeymathâ râ pâyin âvard.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Our rival brought prices down.
\end{quote}

Plural \emph{raqibân}. In sport too: \emph{raqib-e mâ}, our opponent.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{رقیب}} comes from Arabic \emph{raqīb} (EtymDB), a word usually explained as one who watches: a rival keeps an eye on you.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{تبلیغات} (tablighât)}{تبلیغات (tablighât)}]{\fa{تبلیغات} (tablighât) — advertising, advertisements}

\label{lesson:FA-C383-tablighat}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for competition, then the Persian for a rival.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{تبلیغات}}
\textbf{\fa{تبلیغات}} (\emph{tablighât}) — \textquotedblleft{}advertising, advertisements\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{در} \fa{تلویزیون} \fa{تبلیغات} \fa{زیادی} \fa{هست}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{dar televiziyon tablighât-e ziyâdi hast.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
There is a lot of advertising on television.
\end{quote}

The Arabic-style plural of \emph{tabligh} \textquotedblleft{}an advertisement\textquotedblright{}. It can also mean propaganda.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{تبلیغات}} is usually traced to Arabic \emph{tablīgh} \textquotedblleft{}conveying, delivering a message\textquotedblright{}, with the Arabic plural ending \emph{-ât}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 376–383 — a review}

\label{lesson:FA-R383-review-376-383}



\begin{quote}
Say the Persian for a fault and a sin.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a fault, a sin, a weak point, to happen, to admit
  \item a crisis, a solution, to prevent, prevention, to matter
  \item a wage, an income, overtime, a bonus, benefits
  \item to resign, to dismiss, to be dismissed, unemployment, retirement
  \item a CV, a contract, a promotion, a trainee, an internship
  \item a supervisor, a deputy, an expert, a specialist, a duty
  \item a project, to manage, to plan, an organisation, professional
  \item to produce, a product, competition, a rival, advertising
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A fault? (\textbf{\fa{تقصیر}}.) A sin? (\textbf{\fa{گناه}}.) A weak point? (\textbf{\fa{نقطه} \fa{ضعف}}.) To happen? (\textbf{\fa{رخ} \fa{دادن}}.) To admit? (\textbf{\fa{اعتراف} \fa{کردن}}.) A crisis? (\textbf{\fa{بحران}}.) A solution? (\textbf{\fa{راه} \fa{حل}}.) To prevent? (\textbf{\fa{جلوگیری} \fa{کردن}}.) Prevention? (\textbf{\fa{پیشگیری}}.) To matter? (\textbf{\fa{اهمیت} \fa{داشتن}}.) A wage? (\textbf{\fa{دستمزد}}.) An income? (\textbf{\fa{درآمد}}.) Overtime? (\textbf{\fa{اضافه} \fa{کاری}}.) A bonus? (\textbf{\fa{پاداش}}.) Benefits? (\textbf{\fa{مزایا}}.) To resign? (\textbf{\fa{استعفا} \fa{دادن}}.) To dismiss? (\textbf{\fa{اخراج} \fa{کردن}}.) To be dismissed? (\textbf{\fa{اخراج} \fa{شدن}}.) Unemployment? (\textbf{\fa{بیکاری}}.) Retirement? (\textbf{\fa{بازنشستگی}}.) A CV? (\textbf{\fa{رزومه}}.) A contract? (\textbf{\fa{قرارداد}}.) A promotion? (\textbf{\fa{ترفیع}}.) A trainee? (\textbf{\fa{کارآموز}}.) An internship? (\textbf{\fa{کارآموزی}}.) A supervisor? (\textbf{\fa{سرپرست}}.) A deputy? (\textbf{\fa{معاون}}.) An expert? (\textbf{\fa{کارشناس}}.) A specialist? (\textbf{\fa{متخصص}}.) A duty? (\textbf{\fa{وظیفه}}.) A project? (\textbf{\fa{پروژه}}.) To manage? (\textbf{\fa{مدیریت} \fa{کردن}}.) To plan? (\textbf{\fa{برنامه} \fa{ریزی} \fa{کردن}}.) An organisation? (\textbf{\fa{سازمان}}.) Professional? (\textbf{\fa{حرفه} \fa{ای}}.) To produce? (\textbf{\fa{تولید} \fa{کردن}}.) A product? (\textbf{\fa{محصول}}.) Competition? (\textbf{\fa{رقابت}}.) A rival? (\textbf{\fa{رقیب}}.) Advertising? (\textbf{\fa{تبلیغات}}.)
